detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1>: ink lines stay crisp, fog and light move constantly, and the mood is heavy, dark and cinematic like a superhero film set on the docks at night.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, low on his sneakers planted on the wet planks. The camera tilts up slowly and steadily in one continuous move that lasts the whole shot, never pausing and never moving back down: up his baggy jeans, past his hand tightening around the microphone and the cable swinging from it, over the heavy gold chain and the gold tag, to his face. Fog rolls across the dock through the floodlights, a beam of white light cuts through the mist behind him, the warning light on the crane blinks red, and the containers drip. As the camera rises he rolls his heavy shoulders and slowly lifts his chin to stare down into the lens, the floodlight glowing behind his head. The camera is still tilting up as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
Dark water lapping against the dock pilings, a deep ship horn far out in the harbor, the electric hum of the floodlights, the creak of the crane in the wind, the clink of his gold chain and his slow heavy breath.
